W6-L2-Lecture-Examples

Dr. Coleman

Dates and Times

Underlying representations as integers

# Get system date
Sys.Date()
## [1] "2026-02-16"
# Represent as integer
Sys.Date() |>
    as.integer()
## [1] 20500
# Get system time
Sys.time()
## [1] "2026-02-16 13:41:39 CST"
# Represent as integer
Sys.time() |>
    as.integer()
## [1] 1771270899

Working With Dates

library(tidyverse)
## ── Attaching core tidyverse packages ──────────────────────── tidyverse 2.0.0 ──
## ✔ dplyr     1.1.4     ✔ readr     2.1.5
## ✔ forcats   1.0.0     ✔ stringr   1.5.1
## ✔ ggplot2   3.5.2     ✔ tibble    3.3.0
## ✔ lubridate 1.9.4     ✔ tidyr     1.3.1
## ✔ purrr     1.1.0     
## ── Conflicts ────────────────────────────────────────── tidyverse_conflicts() ──
## ✖ dplyr::filter() masks stats::filter()
## ✖ dplyr::lag()    masks stats::lag()
## ℹ Use the conflicted package (<http://conflicted.r-lib.org/>) to force all conflicts to become errors
# all these output the same date
mdy("2/18/2026")
## [1] "2026-02-18"
dmy("18 Feb 2026")
## [1] "2026-02-18"
ymd("2026/02-18")
## [1] "2026-02-18"

Working With Times

ymd_hms("2026-02-18 04:50:13 PM")
## [1] "2026-02-18 16:50:13 UTC"
mdy_hm("2/18/2026 04:50 PM")
## [1] "2026-02-18 16:50:00 UTC"
ymd_hm("2026/2/18 04:50 AM EST") # EST ignored
## [1] "2026-02-18 04:50:00 UTC"

Working With Times/Time Zones

ymd_hm("2026/2/18 04:50 PM EST",
       tz = "America/New_York")
## [1] "2026-02-18 16:50:00 EST"
ymd_hm("2026/2/18 04:50 PM CST",
       tz = "America/Chicago")
## [1] "2026-02-18 16:50:00 CST"
ymd_hm("2026/2/18 04:50 PM CST",
       tz = "CST6CDT")
## [1] "2026-02-18 16:50:00 CST"

Date/Time Operations

Basic difference example

x <- ymd("2012-01-01", tz = "")      ## Midnight 
y <- dmy_hms("9 Jan 2011 11:34:21", tz = "")

x-y
## Time difference of 356.5178 days

Adding datetimes is nonsensical

x + y 

# Error in `+.POSIXt`(x, y) :
# binary '+' is not defined for "POSIXt" objects

Leap Year Example

x <- ymd("2024-03-01")
y <- ymd("2024-02-28") 

x-y
## Time difference of 2 days

UTC and System Time example

x <- ymd_hms("2022-10-25 01:00:00", tz = "")
y <- ymd_hms("2022-10-25 01:00:00", tz = "UTC") 

x-y
## Time difference of 5 hours

Other Helpful Functions

x <- ymd_hms(c("2022-10-25 01:13:46", 
               "2015-04-23 15:11:23"), 
             tz = "")
x
## [1] "2022-10-25 01:13:46 CDT" "2015-04-23 15:11:23 CDT"
year(x)
## [1] 2022 2015
month(x)
## [1] 10  4
day(x)
## [1] 25 23
weekdays(x)
## [1] "Tuesday"  "Thursday"
hour(x)
## [1]  1 15
minute(x)
## [1] 13 11
second(x)
## [1] 46 23
week(x)
## [1] 43 17

## Convert date variables into R date format
dat <- dat |>
    mutate(datetime = mdy_hms(`Created Date`, tz = ""),
           close = mdy_hms(`Close Date`, tz = ""))

## Look at newly created variables
dat |>
    select(`Created Date`, datetime, close)

## Show total number of service requests by month
dat |>
    mutate(month = month(datetime)) |>
    group_by(month) |>
    summarize(n = n()) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, 
                       labels = month.abb)

month.abb
##  [1] "Jan" "Feb" "Mar" "Apr" "May" "Jun" "Jul" "Aug" "Sep" "Oct" "Nov" "Dec"
month.name
##  [1] "January"   "February"  "March"     "April"     "May"       "June"     
##  [7] "July"      "August"    "September" "October"   "November"  "December"
## Show total number of service requests by month and year
dat |>
    mutate(month = month(datetime),
           year = year(datetime)) |>
    group_by(year, month) |>
    summarize(n = n()) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(vars(year)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'year'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.

## Distribution of time to close a service request
dat |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime),
           closedate = as.Date(close)) |>
    select(date, closedate) |>
    mutate(timetoclose = as.integer(closedate - date)) |>
    select(timetoclose) |>
    summary()
##   timetoclose     
##  Min.   :   0.00  
##  1st Qu.:   1.00  
##  Median :   2.00  
##  Mean   :  15.79  
##  3rd Qu.:   8.00  
##  Max.   :1245.00  
##  NA's   :550
## Plot distribution of time to close a service request
dat |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime),
           closedate = as.Date(close)) |>
    select(date, closedate) |>
    mutate(timetoclose = as.integer(closedate - date)) |>
    select(timetoclose) |>
    filter(!is.na(timetoclose)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = timetoclose)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20)

## Look at times less than 60 days
dat |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime),
           closedate = as.Date(close)) |>
    select(date, closedate) |>
    mutate(timetoclose = as.integer(closedate - date)) |>
    filter(!is.na(timetoclose)) |>
    filter(timetoclose < 60) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = timetoclose)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20)

## Show daily number of service requests
dat |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarize(n = n()) |>
    arrange(date) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = date, y = n)) +
    geom_line()

## Show daily number of service requests by ZIP code
dat |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) |>
    rename(zipcode = `Zip Code`) |>
    group_by(zipcode, date) |>
    summarize(n = n()) |>
    arrange(date) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = date, y = n)) +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(vars(zipcode))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'zipcode'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
